checkpoint_runtime_parity.explanation: All held-out images, shared current app quality policy and each model's frozen confidence thresholds; checkpoint canonical transform matches raw runtime input

calibration.selection: Validation-only deployed FP16 runtime scores with frozen quality gate; >=15 accepted and >=90%/95% validation precision per class

quality.selection: validation-only severe Gaussianblur challenge balancedaccuracy subject to >=90% clear acceptance

calibration.runtime: ai-edge-litert CPU float16 storage / float32 computation

external_rust.threshold_selection: B0's previously validation-selected threshold, frozen before this comparison
external_rust.status: Previously inspected external development stress test; no checkpoint or gate selection on this source
external_rust.qualification: NoRust is binary-negative ground truth only; it cannot score healthy or other disease predictions

external_scans.status: Previously inspected separate-source stress test; flatbed scans, not camera photographs
external_scans.qualification: Paired leaf sides repeat physical leaves; Mycena/Ojo maps to unsupported, never cercospora

far_probe.selection: One seeded example per source/group/label from the frozen expanded test; identical images for both models
far_probe.image_transform: Shrink canonical 224px crop to 146px, center it on a 224px median-RGB canvas; identical raw pixels for both models
far_probe.qualification: Synthetic distance stress, not evidence from genuine distant field photographs; differs from full-image padding used in training
